name: @lakutata/template-service
description: The service template of the lakutata projects: an HTTP API deployed as a Docker image.
author: alex.ma

features.i18n: The messages in several languages (lakutata/com/i18n): src/locales, the language of each request
features.installer: The installers of the application (lakutata package installer): deb, rpm and tar.gz on Linux (npm run package:linux in Docker), pkg and tar.gz on macOS, nsis, msi and zip on Windows, its service registered (systemd, launchd, WinSW), its program in the PATH
